title: Crescent moon with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='moonGlow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFF9C4'/>
      <stop offset='70%' stop-color='#FFE082'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#FFCA28'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='crescentGradient' cx='40%' cy='40%' r='60%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFEB3B'/>
      <stop offset='60%' stop-color='#FDD835'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#F9A825'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- glow aura -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='42' fill='#FFF9C4' opacity='0.12'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='36' fill='#FFE082' opacity='0.1'/>
  <!-- crescent moon body -->
  <path d='M 62 14
           A 36 36 0 1 0 62 86
           A 28 28 0 1 1 62 14 Z'
        fill='url(#crescentGradient)'
        stroke='#FFF59D' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- face -->
  <!-- left eye -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='42' rx='4' ry='5.5' fill='#5D4037'/>
  <ellipse cx='36.8' cy='40.5' rx='1.8' ry='1.8' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- right eye -->
  <ellipse cx='52' cy='40' rx='4' ry='5.5' fill='#5D4037'/>
  <ellipse cx='50.8' cy='38.5' rx='1.8' ry='1.8' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M 36 54 Q 45 66 56 52'
        fill='none' stroke='#5D4037' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- rosy cheeks -->
  <ellipse cx='33' cy='51' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#FF8A65' opacity='0.6'/>
  <ellipse cx='56' cy='49' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#FF8A65' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- sparkle stars -->
  <g fill='#FFF9C4'>
    <path d='M 74 25 L 75.5 30 L 80 31.5 L 75.5 33 L 74 38 L 72.5 33 L 68 31.5 L 72.5 30 Z' opacity='0.9'/>
    <path d='M 82 58 L 83 61.5 L 86.5 62.5 L 83 63.5 L 82 67 L 81 63.5 L 77.5 62.5 L 81 61.5 Z' opacity='0.7'/>
    <path d='M 68 72 L 69 75 L 72 76 L 69 77 L 68 80 L 67 77 L 64 76 L 67 75 Z' opacity='0.8'/>
  </g>
</svg>
